visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera follows a man wearing a navy varsity jacket with white sleeves and baggy light-blue jeans through a bright, modern office. He looks down at his smartphone with a neutral expression, his hands steady as he walks past rows of desks and glass partitions. (2) In a quick cut, the man is now at a coffee station. He stands before a high-end espresso machine, placing a cup with deliberate movements while looking at the equipment with focused intent. The background shows a large window with a city view. (3) The scene shifts to the man walking out of a large revolving glass door. He carries a blue shopping bag in one hand. He maintains a steady, purposeful gait as he enters the outdoor daylight area of a building entrance. (4) The man is seen walking across a rainbow-painted pedestrian crossing in a busy urban intersection. He looks around with a cool, confident expression, his arms swinging slightly in rhythm. Buildings and traffic are visible in the background under bright daylight. (5) A transition shows him riding a grey bicycle down a paved path lined with green trees. He wears the same outfit, pedaling with a relaxed but determined posture, looking straight ahead. Other parked bikes and city infrastructure are visible. (6) He walks past another man in a grey suit on a city sidewalk. As he passes, he performs a small, rhythmic hop-step, his hands moving slightly as if feeling a beat. The setting is a clean, modern urban walkway next to a glass building. (7) A close-up shot focuses on his baggy light-blue jeans and black shoes as he walks with a bouncy, rhythmic cadence. The camera follows the motion of his legs against the grey pavement of a city street. (8) The final shot shows him running away from the camera in a wide-open urban plaza. He runs with a light, energetic bounce, disappearing into the distance as the video ends. The lighting is bright and natural.
